name: Wbcom Designs – BuddyPress Check-ins
author: wbcomdesigns

sections.description:
BuddyPress Check-ins adds a place to your community. Members click the map marker in the activity composer, type a location, pick it from Google’s autocomplete suggestions, and the activity posts with a map of that spot. Every place a member saves also lands on a “Check-ins” tab on their profile, with a map of everywhere they have been.

Check-ins works with both BuddyPress and BuddyBoss Platform, in member activity and inside groups.

This plugin needs a Google Maps API key with billing enabled on the Google Cloud project. Google requires this for the Places and Geocoding APIs the plugin calls. Without a key, the check-in marker does not appear and nothing is stored. Google’s free monthly usage tier covers small and mid-sized communities, but the billing account has to exist before any request succeeds. Paste the key at WB Plugins > Check-ins > General and use the Verify button to confirm it works before you tell members about the feature.

What you get

Check in from the activity composer
* A map marker in the activity composer opens the check-in panel.
* Google Places autocomplete suggests locations as the member types.
* The posted activity shows the chosen place with a map below it.
* Optionally save the place to the member’s Check-ins tab at the same time.
* Check-ins survive activity editing: edit the text, keep the place.
* Maps also render in embedded activity.

A Check-ins tab on every member profile
* A paginated list of every place the member has saved, with dates.
* View or trash any single row, or select all and bulk delete.
* An aggregate map showing all of the member’s saved places at once.
* A clear empty state before the first check-in.
* Rename the tab or turn it off entirely from the settings.

Check-ins in groups
* Members can attach a place to activity posted in a group.
* Group check-ins read as “checked-in in the group X” in the stream.

A Location field on member profiles
* The plugin creates a “Location” xProfile field for you.
* Google autocomplete binds to it, so members pick a real place rather than typing free text.
* The place, latitude and longitude are saved together, and the field renders as a Google Maps link on the profile.
* Turn the field on or off with the “Profile location field” setting.

Find check-ins in the stream
* The activity dropdown gets a filter that shows check-ins only.

Admin settings and overview
* An Overview dashboard: how many members have checked in, whether the API key is set and verified, and a summary of the current configuration.
* General settings: Check-ins tab on or off, tab label, profile location field on or off, and the Google Maps API key.
* One-click Verify tests your key against the Google endpoints the plugin uses, including a specific check for billing being disabled on the project.
* An admin bar link straight to your Check-ins tab.

Perfect For

  • Local and regional communities where place is the point
  • Travel, cycling, running and outdoor communities logging where members have been
  • Event and meetup communities sharing venues
  • Any BuddyPress or BuddyBoss site that wants richer activity than plain text

Premium Support

Our dedicated support team is ready to help you get the most out of this plugin. Whether you need help with setup, customization, or troubleshooting, we’re here to assist.

Documentation

  • Documentation and Support – Setup walkthrough, settings reference, and usage guides

Translations

  • English (default)
  • Ready for translation in your language with included POT file
  • RTL language support included

Links

  • Plugin Homepage
  • Documentation
  • Support
  • Request Features

Compatibility

  • WordPress 6.5 and higher
  • PHP 8.0 and higher
  • BuddyPress or BuddyBoss Platform, with the Activity component active
  • A Google Maps API key on a Google Cloud project with billing enabled
  • Works with Youzer and Youzify member profiles
  • Tested with popular themes including BuddyX and Reign

What’s New in 2.5.0

A modern card-panel admin with an Overview dashboard and a one-click API key verifier, plus an accessibility, dark mode, and RTL pass across the check-in views. Members on a browser without geolocation now get a clear message instead of a silent script failure, and the plugin makes fewer Google Maps API calls per page load.

More Free Tools from Wbcom Designs

These other free tools from Wbcom Designs fill in every other direction, from the theme and the network itself to forums, media, events, gamification, directories, jobs, and courses.

  • BuddyX – A free, fast community theme for BuddyPress, BuddyBoss and PeepSo with a modern layout and dark mode.
  • BuddyNext – Stand up a complete WordPress community with activity streams, member spaces, profiles, direct messaging, and built-in moderation.
  • Jetonomy – Add forums, question-and-answer boards, and idea spaces that stay tidy through trust-based auto-moderation even past 100,000 topics.
  • Mediaverse – Let members build photo and video albums, react, follow each other, and message privately while AI moderation keeps things clean.
  • Eventonomy – Run community events with RSVPs, calendars, and front-end submissions.
  • WB Gamification – Reward members with points, badges, and leaderboards to keep engagement high.
  • Listora – Publish searchable directories across ten listing types with reviews, maps, and member-submitted entries from the front end.
  • WP Career Board – Add a job board with front-end listings, applications, and employer profiles.
  • Learnomy – Build and sell online courses, auto-grade quizzes, collect payments, and award certificates when learners finish.
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation (Recommended)

  1. Log in to your WordPress admin dashboard
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  3. Choose the bp-check-in ZIP file and click “Install Now”
  4. After installation, click “Activate”
  5. Create a Google Maps API key (see “Set up the Google Maps API key” below) – the plugin does nothing until you do
  6. Go to WB Plugins > Check-ins > General, paste the key, and click “Verify”
  7. Save the settings, then post an activity update and click the map marker to test

Manual Installation

  1. Upload the entire bp-check-in folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Follow steps 5 to 7 above to add and verify the Google Maps API key

Set up the Google Maps API key

The plugin calls Google’s Places and Geocoding APIs, and Google will not answer either one without a key on a billed project. This is a Google requirement, not a plugin limitation.

  1. Create a project in the Google Cloud Console
  2. Enable billing on that project. Google rejects the requests this plugin makes with a PROJECT_BILLING_DISABLED error until you do, even inside the free usage tier
  3. Enable the Maps JavaScript API, Places API, and Geocoding API for the project
  4. Create an API key under Credentials, and restrict it to your site’s domain
  5. Paste the key at WB Plugins > Check-ins > General and click “Verify”

The Verify button tests the key against every Google endpoint the plugin uses and tells you exactly which one failed, including whether billing is the problem. The Overview tab shows the key’s status at a glance. Our guide to creating a Google Maps API key walks through the console screens.

Requirements

  • WordPress 6.5 or higher
  • PHP 8.0 or higher (8.0+ recommended)
  • BuddyPress or BuddyBoss Platform, installed and activated, with the Activity component enabled
  • A Google Maps API key on a Google Cloud project with billing enabled. Without it, the check-in marker does not appear and no location is saved
  • Members must allow their browser’s location permission to use the check-in panel
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work with both BuddyPress and BuddyBoss?

Yes, this plugin works seamlessly with both BuddyPress and BuddyBoss platforms.

Does this plugin require BuddyPress or BuddyBoss to be installed?

Yes. BuddyPress or BuddyBoss Platform must be installed and activated, with the Activity component enabled. The plugin checks for this itself and explains the problem in the admin if either is missing.

Do I really need a Google Maps API key?

Yes. It is not optional. The plugin is inert without one: the map marker never appears in the activity composer, the check-in panel never renders, the Google Maps script is never loaded, and no location can be saved. Add and verify a key at WB Plugins > Check-ins > General before rolling the feature out to members.

Does the API key need billing enabled?

Yes. Google requires an active billing account on the Cloud project before the Places and Geocoding APIs will answer, even for usage inside the free monthly tier. A key without billing returns PROJECT_BILLING_DISABLED and the plugin cannot save a place. The Verify button reports this specific error so you know that billing, not the key itself, is what needs fixing.

Does this plugin require location services?

Yes. The check-in map and the autocomplete search box only load once the browser reports the member’s position. If a member blocks the location permission, or the browser has no geolocation support, the check-in panel has no autocomplete and cannot be used. Members see a clear message rather than a broken panel.

How can we add a place when posting?

Go to your profile’s post update section and click the map marker icon. The icon appears only once a Google Maps API key is saved in the settings. Type in the autocomplete box, select a location, and a map will display it.

Where can I see all check-ins?

Two places. The activity dropdown menu has a filter that shows check-ins only, on both BuddyPress and BuddyBoss. Each member also gets a “Check-ins” tab on their profile listing every place they have saved, with a map of all of them.

Can members set a location on their profile?

Yes. With the “Profile location field” setting enabled, the plugin creates a “Location” xProfile field and binds Google autocomplete to it, so members pick a real place instead of typing free text. The saved place renders on the profile as a Google Maps link.

Can members check in inside groups?

Yes. Members can attach a place to activity they post in a group, and it reads as “checked-in in the group X” in the stream.

Can I rename or hide the Check-ins tab?

Yes. At WB Plugins > Check-ins > General you can turn the profile Check-ins tab off entirely, or rename its label.

Can members delete their check-ins?

Yes. The Check-ins tab lists each saved place with view and trash actions per row, plus select-all and bulk delete for clearing several at once.

Will this work with my theme?

The plugin follows BuddyPress template standards and has been tested with popular BuddyPress and BuddyBoss themes including BuddyX and Reign, as well as Youzer and Youzify member profiles.

Is the plugin translation ready?

Yes. The plugin is fully translation ready with an included POT file, and includes RTL language support.

Where can I get support?

We offer comprehensive support through multiple channels:
* Documentation – Free guides for every Wbcom plugin
* Support – Get help from our team
* Contact us – Report bugs and request features
sections.changelog:
2.5.0 – July 2026

Modern card-panel admin, plus a front-end accessibility, dark mode, and RTL pass on the check-in views.

  • New – Modern Wbcom card-panel admin settings screen with sidebar tabs, an Overview dashboard, Pro features, and a Support FAQ.
  • New – Added German, Spanish, Italian and Portuguese (Brazil) translations, and completed the existing Dutch and Hindi ones.
  • Improve – Reduced Google Maps API usage by accepting a device position up to five minutes old, instead of requesting a fresh fix on every page load.
  • Improve – The Pro Features tab now uses semantic description-list markup so screen readers can pair each feature with its description.
  • Improve – Dark mode now covers the map frame so an empty or still loading map no longer shows as a bright block.
  • Improve – Replaced browser alert and confirm dialogs with accessible toast and confirmation modals.
  • Improve – Expanded dark mode coverage, keyboard focus-visible rings, and pagination aria-current on the check-in activity views.
  • Improve – Converted front-end and admin CSS to logical properties so RTL layouts flip correctly.
  • Improve – Made the profile check-ins map and read-more map responsive on small screens.
  • Fix – Members on a browser without geolocation now see a clear message instead of the check-in script failing with a script error.
  • Fix – Corrected an invalid inline style that collapsed the profile check-ins map width.
  • Fix – Replaced the non-standard attr-key attribute with a standard data attribute on the trash control.
  • Fix – Added a form action so bulk actions no longer POST to a paginated URL.
  • Fix – None of the bundled translations could load. The text domain was not registered, the files were named for a different domain, and the French and Dutch files used locale codes WordPress does not recognise. All five locales now work.
  • Fix – JavaScript translations could never load in production: the translation file lookup used the minified script path, which never matches the file the build produces.
  • Fix – The delete confirmation and the location picker strings had no translatable source.
  • Security – Added explicit logged-in checks to the save-location and delete-check-in AJAX handlers.
  • Fix – The Profile location field is now visible on the profile edit page so members can set their location, and renders as a Google Maps link on the profile view. It was previously hidden on both.
  • Fix – Corrected two POST field name typos (tab visibilty, xprofile filed) so the toggles read and write the same key.
  • Fix – Corrected double-escaped ampersands in the Support and FAQ heading and the Pro features tab.
  • Fix – The admin geolocation lookup now handles a denied or unavailable position instead of silently swallowing the error.
  • Fix – Completed and corrected the Activity Check-Ins string across Spanish, Italian, Portuguese (Brazil), Hindi and German (formal), and fixed several Hindi strings that had lost meaning or tense.
  • Dev – Removed the legacy shared admin wrapper, the unused Font Awesome assets, and leftover console logging.
  • Dev – Cleaned obsolete and fuzzy entries out of the French and Hindi translation files.

  • Security: Fixed multiple XSS vulnerabilities for improved site protection.

  • Security: Updated to use secure HTTPS protocol throughout the plugin.

  • Fix: Fixed check-in tab visibility for all logged-in users.

  • Fix: Check-in location now saves correctly when editing activity.
  • Enhancement: Added helper function for latitude and longitude validation.
